display.purpose: Landing hero headline. Once per page; never in the dashboard.

body.purpose: Table cells, labels, controls. The dashboard lives here.

label.purpose: Pills, badges and column chips. Small and heavy.

numeric.purpose: Every monetary value, count and countdown. Tabular figures so dinar columns align down the page.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Near-invisible seat under cards, tiles and the table at rest.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover on a card or stat tile, paired with translateY(-2px).

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Popovers and the column filter panel, appended to body to escape table clipping.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset navy ring so focus never changes an element's footprint.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover and colour changes.

motion.name: motion-xl
motion.purpose: Page-level reveals on the landing surface.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for entry and lift.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Longer reveals that should settle hard.

motion.name: ease-back-out
motion.purpose: The single overshoot easing, used for the new-lot pulse.

components.name: Brand Seal
components.description: The scales-of-justice mark. The only illustrative element in the system; once per page in the brand lockup.
components.html: وزارة العدل الأردنيةلوحة المزادات
components.css: .ds-lockup { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; direction: rtl; } .ds-seal { width: 42px; height: 42px; flex: none; } .ds-wordmark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #7B8499; } .ds-title { font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Cambria, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1F2E; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: A card that is also a filter control. Click filters the table; the hover lift is the only affordance saying so.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; align-items: flex-start; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5DFD3; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(14,36,56,.06); padding: 11px 14px; cursor: pointer; text-align: start; direction: rtl; transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 360ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.45rem; color: #1A1F2E; } .ds-stat-label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: .75rem; color: #7B8499; } .ds-stat:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14,36,56,.06), 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(14,36,56,.22); } .ds-stat:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1B3A57 inset, 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.06); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Category badge and re-announcement marker. Fully round, gold-on-gold-soft.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #FBF6E8; color: #A88840; direction: rtl; }

components.name: Freshness Indicator
components.description: Landing-page data-age badge. Green under 24h, gold past 24h, red past 72h — the one place colour encodes a threshold.
components.html: آخر تحديث قبل ٣١ ساعة
components.css: .ds-fresh { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 7px 15px 7px 13px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: .84rem; direction: rtl; background: #E6F0EC; color: #3D7A6A; } .ds-fresh-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; flex: none; } .ds-fresh--stale { background: #FBF6E8; color: #A88840; } .ds-fresh--old { background: #FBF2F2; color: #B73E3E; }

components.name: Data Table Header
components.description: Navy sticky header with a per-column filter chip. The dashboard's primary surface.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; direction: rtl; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5DFD3; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: .85rem; } .ds-table thead th { background: #1B3A57; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; font-size: .78rem; padding: 9px 11px; text-align: start; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody td { padding: 9px 11px; border-top: 1px solid #E5DFD3; color: #3D4859; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #EEF2F6; } .ds-num { font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: .98rem; color: #1A1F2E; } .ds-colfilter { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0 4px; margin-inline-start: 4px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); cursor: pointer; font-size: .8rem; } .ds-colfilter:hover { color: #C9A961; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: RECORDED DRIFT: Bootstrap's default shape with only --bs-primary remapped. Shown as built, not as intended. Note the 6px radius against the system's 14px card token.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1B3A57; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #1B3A57; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; direction: rtl; transition: background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0E2438; border-color: #0E2438; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .25rem rgba(27,58,87,.35); }

narrative.overview:
This is a public register, not a product. It inherits its authority from the thing it documents — court-ordered auctions executed under Jordan's execution law — and its job is to be legible under scrutiny. The scales-of-justice seal, the serif display face, and the parchment ground all say the same thing: this is a record you can cite, not a dashboard trying to sell you something.

But it is a warm record, not a cold one. The ground is parchment (#FAF8F4), never white-grey; the accent is gold, never corporate blue; the rules between rows are a soft tan (#E5DFD3) rather than a hard grey line. That warmth is deliberate and load-bearing — it is what keeps a screen of 300 dense rows from reading as an enterprise data table. Density and warmth are not in tension here; the warmth is what makes the density bearable.

Precision is the other half. Every number is tabular-lined and set in the serif, so columns of dinars align down the page and a price can be compared at a glance without reading it. The interface is dense on purpose: filters on every column, stat tiles that are themselves filters, and as many lots per screen as legibility allows. A visitor is here to compare lots and catch a deadline, not to browse.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment ground, never white — warmth is a system invariant
Serif for display and for every number; sans for body and controls
Gold is a seal, used sparingly; red means a deadline, never decoration
Flat at rest, lifting only on hover
Arabic RTL first, and the only language

rules.name: The Parchment Rule
rules.body: The page ground is #FAF8F4 and never pure white. White is a surface that sits on the ground; if the two are ever the same value, cards stop existing.

rules.name: The Gold Is A Seal Rule
rules.body: Treasury Gold marks provenance and status — the seal, a re-announcement, a staleness warning. It is never a call to action and never a large fill. If gold covers more than a badge, it has stopped being a seal.

rules.name: The Red Means Time Rule
rules.body: Hammer Red is reserved for deadlines and newness. It is not an error colour, not a brand colour, and not available for emphasis. A red cell on this screen must always mean the clock.

rules.name: The Tabular Serif Rule
rules.body: Numbers are set in the display serif with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, not in the body sans. Columns of dinars must align on the decimal down a 300-row table; this is the reason the serif exists in the body of the page at all.

rules.name: The No Webfont Rule
rules.body: The type stack is system-local by design. Do not add a Google Font or any webfont — it would delay first paint on a mobile connection and would not improve the Arabic rendering, which is the only language here.

rules.name: The Navy Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are rgba(14,36,56,…). A neutral-black shadow on #FAF8F4 reads as dirt, not depth.

dos: Do keep the page ground on Parchment (#FAF8F4) and reserve white for surfaces that sit on it.
Do set every number in the serif with tabular-nums, so columns align.
Do tint shadows with rgba(14,36,56,…), never neutral black.
Do use logical properties (margin-inline-start, padding-inline) — the entire interface is RTL.
Do append popovers and dropdowns to <body> when they originate inside .table-responsive, which would otherwise clip them.
Do treat the 14px card radius as the signature shape.
donts: Don't use Hammer Red for anything except deadlines and newness. It is not an error colour and not available for emphasis.
Don't let Treasury Gold grow beyond a badge, seal or marker. Gold at scale stops being a seal.
Don't add a webfont. The stack is system-local so Arabic resolves to the platform face and first paint is immediate.
Don't combine Bootstrap's .rounded / .shadow-sm / .bg-white utilities with a card — their !important silently overrides the radius token.
Don't set overflow: hidden on .table-responsive; it breaks horizontal scroll on mobile, where the table is read by scrolling across.
Don't treat the current button styling as the system's intent. Components inherit Bootstrap's shape with only the palette remapped — this is recorded drift, not a decision.
Don't define the same token twice under different names. The landing page calls it --navy and the dashboard calls it --color-primary for the same #1B3A57; converge on one, do not add a third.
